scope: Direct source-context review of this batch only. T temporal/state/order; P price/priority predicate; N non-temporal/declaration/transport control. Every inventoried site has a manually described context by source focus start; original operators and outcome metadata preserved. No claim of independent evaluation of every compound expression or downstream dynamic call.

For each run select stop=lower_bound(starts,query start), first=lower_bound(ends,query end,0,stop); yield [first,stop) in order. Stored start strictly earlier, stored end inclusive; no reorder/dedup.

Counters start1, accumulate only same-rank same-verdict. For F remove prior repair >= current source (default -1); try current repair. Replace repeat, no final sweep.

First or nonincreasing number starts series, preserves prior end/max end, resets starts/prefix/flag. Else pending restart sets verdict start to current. Update previous number.
T iff difference from verdict start even; retain prefix only number <= largest prior end.

At number equal previous or largest historical end, and closure callback absent or truthy, mark all prefix repeated and recalculate parity from group start; set restart, retain prefix. Callback short-circuits.

Exact Boolean true chooses progress sink, else no-op; context controls restoration.

Outer LiveRawChanged sends RAW_CHANGED and exit1.
Ordinary Exception diagnostic and LIVE_ENGINE_FAILED exit1; other BaseException not caught. EOF exit0; IO failures may propagate.
